name: 32005-fewactivelora-7b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), x86 host.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- 13.5 GB of fp16 weights plus four rank-8 adapter slots on one 80 GB card.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams swept at 96, 64 and 8 in that order, each bounded at 1200 requests / 1800 s, warmup 10% and cooldown 10% by completion. The SCORED point is the first, streams=96; 8 is the source's own quoted concurrency and is kept in the same run for comparison. The sweep runs upward from the source's point because a load that saturated the source's card leaves this one idle. Sizing: 96 streams x 384 resident tokens = 36,864 tokens against a KV pool of roughly 116,000 (80 GB x 0.90, less 13.5 GB of weights, at 512 KB/token), so nothing is preempted, and `max-num-seqs: 256` admits all 96 into one decode batch.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no shared prefix, exactly 128 prompt tokens and exactly 256 output tokens (min = max on both), greedy at temperature 0.0 with ignore_eos, prefix caching off -- so every request is one prefill and 255 decode steps. Every request carries an adapter: `scenario.json: backend.lora_modules` declares two names, `lora1` and `lora2`, resolving to `bkpandey/Llama-2-7b-hf_finetuned_finance_jupyter` and its `_v2` sibling, applied round-robin, so there is no un-adapted traffic and two DISTINCT adapters are active in every batch. Both are rank-8 PEFT adapters over this same base with the same seven target modules (q, k, v, o, gate, up, down), 80 MB each, ungated. `yard1/llama-2-7b-sql-lora-test`, the adapter this item first named, cannot be loaded by this engine: it also LoRA-ises `embed_tokens`/`lm_head` at vocabulary 32004 and this vLLM has dropped extra-vocab LoRA, so the load raises `The embedding LoRA size(32004) must be consistent with the base model's vocabulary size(32000)` (`vllm/lora/lora_model.py:108`). `request_format: plain` is required, not cosmetic -- this base checkpoint ships no chat template and the backend's default would apply one and fail every request.
purpose: A finance analytics assistant on a 7B model, serving short fixed-length prompts across two adapters at 96 concurrent streams on one GPU.
launch:
# Flat `key: value` only. An indented line is skipped, so a structured value must stay on ONE
# line or the key is dropped and the engine starts without it.
#
# `--lora-modules` is ABSENT because it is API-server surface, not an `AsyncEngineArgs` field,
# and the engine runs in-process with no API server. The adapter names this workload sends
# traffic to are declared request-side, in `scenario.json: backend.lora_modules`.

model: NousResearch/Llama-2-7b-hf

enable-lora: true

max-loras: 4
max-lora-rank: 8

enable-prefix-caching: false

max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 256

tensor-parallel-size: 1

dtype: float16

max-model-len: 4096

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
